options.why: P[k] retains the exact sum of width-times-rate contributions for the k completed tiers before final division.
Flooring prefix fees would lose fractional contributions needed when the query crosses several tiers.
One current rate cannot summarize the contributions of completed tiers with different rates.
The prefix is built from tier bounds and rates, independently of the later query volumes.

items.explanation: Retain exact contributions until final division.
